genres.name: Literary Fiction
genres.description: Character-driven stories focused on style, theme, and psychological depth rather than plot.

genres.name: Historical Fiction
genres.description: Stories set in a real past era, blending fictional characters with historical context.

genres.name: Romance
genres.description: Stories centered on a romantic relationship with an emotionally satisfying ending.

genres.name: Mystery
genres.description: A puzzle-driven story where a crime or secret must be solved.

genres.name: Thriller
genres.description: Fast-paced stories built on tension, danger, and high stakes.

genres.name: Crime
genres.description: Stories focused on criminal activity, law enforcement, or the justice system.

genres.name: Horror
genres.description: Stories intended to evoke fear, dread, or psychological unease.

genres.name: Science Fiction
genres.description: Speculative stories based on futuristic science, technology, or space exploration.

genres.name: Fantasy
genres.description: Stories set in imaginary worlds with magic or supernatural elements.

genres.name: Dystopian
genres.description: Stories set in oppressive or broken societies, often as a warning.

genres.name: Young Adult
genres.description: Stories aimed at teens, often focusing on identity, growth, and first experiences.

genres.name: New Adult
genres.description: Stories about early adulthood, independence, and transitions into mature life.

genres.name: Adventure
genres.description: Stories driven by journeys, exploration, and exciting challenges.

genres.name: Action
genres.description: Stories emphasizing physical conflict, combat, and high-energy sequences.

genres.name: Paranormal
genres.description: Stories involving supernatural elements within a real-world setting.

genres.name: Urban Fantasy
genres.description: Fantasy stories set in modern cities where magic exists alongside reality.

genres.name: Magical Realism
genres.description: Realistic settings where subtle magical elements are treated as normal.

genres.name: Western
genres.description: Stories set in the American frontier, often involving lawlessness and survival.

genres.name: Satire
genres.description: Stories that use humor, irony, or exaggeration to critique society or politics.

genres.name: Speculative Fiction
genres.description: Broad genre exploring imaginative 'what if' scenarios beyond real-world constraints.
